summary: Unifi, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary UMI entered a Real Estate Purchase and Sale Agreement to sell industrial/manufacturing property in Yadkin County, NC to Enovum Data Centers Corp. for $60.0 million cash. An earnest money deposit of $2.25 million escrows, with $1.0 million potentially non-refundable. Closing is scheduled 45 days after the September 15, 2026 inspection period expiration, subject to energy capacity confirmation, approvals, and leaseback terms. Indemnification applies above $0.1 million up to 3% of price. Net proceeds repay term loan debt. Watch for closing conditions and leaseback agreements.
